def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def bbox(g):
    P=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v]
    return min(i for i,_ in P),min(j for _,j in P),max(i for i,_ in P),max(j for _,j in P)

for n in ['1','2','3','4']:
    gi,go=G['Demo pair '+n+' input'],G['Demo pair '+n+' output']
    ti,li,bi,ri=bbox(gi); to,lo,bo,ro=bbox(go)
    midc=(li+ri)//2; midr=(ti+bi)//2
    # input side ring thicknesses along mid lines
    ith_t=0
    while gi[ti+ith_t][midc]==gi[ti][li]: ith_t+=1
    ith_b=0
    while gi[bi-ith_b][midc]==gi[ti][li]: ith_b+=1
    ith_l=0
    while gi[midr][li+ith_l]==gi[ti][li]: ith_l+=1
    ith_r=0
    while gi[midr][ri-ith_r]==gi[ti][li]: ith_r+=1
    core=gi[ti+ith_t][midc]
    oth_t=0
    while go[to+oth_t][lo+2]==go[to][lo]: oth_t+=1
    oth_b=0
    while go[bo-oth_b][lo+2]==go[to][lo]: oth_b+=1
    oth_l=0
    while go[to+2][lo+oth_l]==go[to][lo]: oth_l+=1
    oth_r=0
    while go[to+2][ro-oth_r]==go[to][lo]: oth_r+=1
    print(f"demo{n}: in bbox {(bi-ti+1,ri-li+1)} core color {core} in_ring(t,b,l,r)=({ith_t},{ith_b},{ith_l},{ith_r}) out_ring=({oth_t},{oth_b},{oth_l},{oth_r}) in_size={(bi-ti+1,ri-li+1)} out_size={(bo-to+1,ro-lo+1)}")

def tnew(w,h):
    return 2*min(w,h)-max(w,h)
for (w,h,exp) in [(3,4,2),(1,1,1),(2,2,2),(3,3,3)]:

def transform(g):
    t,l,b,r=bbox(g)
    ring=g[t][l]
    mc=(l+r)//2
    th=0
    while g[t+th][mc]==ring: th+=1
    core=g[t+th][mc]
    # core dims
    ci=[i for i in range(t,b+1) if core in g[i][l:r+1]]
    cj=[j for j in range(l,r+1) if any(g[i][j]==core for i in range(t,b+1))]
    ch,cw=len(ci),len(cj)
    nt=2*min(ch,cw)-max(ch,cw)
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(max(0,t-nt),min(H,b+nt+1)):
        for j in range(max(0,l-nt),min(W,r+nt+1)):
            if i<t or i>b or j<l or j>r:
                out[i][j]=core
    return out

ok=all(transform(G['Demo pair %d input'%n])==G['Demo pair %d output'%n] for n in [1,2,3,4])
print("all demos reproduced:", ok)

def transform2(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(g[i])]; cols=[j for j in range(W) if any(g[r][j] for r in range(H))]
    t,b,l,r=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    ring=g[t][l]
    mid=(t+b)//2
    th=0
    while t+th<=b and g[t+th][mid]==ring: th+=1
    core=g[t+th][mid]
    cr=[i for i in range(t+th,b-th+1) if any(g[i][j]==core for j in range(l+th,r-th+1))]
    cc=[j for j in range(l+th,r-th+1) if any(g[i][j]==core for i in range(t+th,b+1))]
    ch,cw=len(cr),len(cc)
    nt=min(ch,2*th)-(1 if cw!=ch else 0)
    nt=max(nt,1)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if t-nt<=i<=b+nt and l-nt<=j<=r+nt and not(t<=i<=b and l<=j<=r):
                out[i][j]=core
    return out
# verify on demos

def nested_rect_layers(grid):
